alt: 同學們對撕毀作品的霸凌行為一同感到氣憤，並肩站出來保護受欺負的孩子，堅定地示意對方停止，老師也正趕來協助。
scene_prompt: 同仇敵愾 means united indignation and standing together against a common aggressor. Modern school courtyard anti-bullying situation, four children and a distant teacher. Three classmates stand firmly shoulder to shoulder, faces showing shared righteous disapproval, protecting a younger frightened classmate's school art project behind them from an older bully standing a safe distance in front. To avoid too many figures, make the protected child ONE of the three, standing slightly behind two defenders; total FOUR children only: two defenders, one protected child, one bully. The bully has deliberately torn a simple flower poster whose torn halves lie by his shoes and still holds a loose ripped corner, making wrongdoing clear. Defenders face the same bully together, one extends a calm stop palm, the other stands steadfastly beside them; no fists or fighting, no revenge, no weapons. A teacher in distant background is approaching to help. Clear united resistance to shared threat rather than ganging up on an innocent child. Natural anatomy, no extra arms, believable hands, grounded shoes and objects. All art papers contain pictures only, absolutely no writing.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2. NO text, letters, numerals, captions, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Clear visual storytelling for elementary school readers and readable at mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass green, pale sky blue, warm earthy browns, generous ivory breathing room. No flat digital blocks, glossy rendering, 3D or imitation of a named artist.
